title: WHAT THE…
body:
I woke up to is morning to find that Routinery had charged me for a year subscription of $35. I never signed up for a free trial or anything like that, and I cannot figure out how they managed to do this, other than that I recently transferred apps to a new device and I guess there was some way of getting me through that process. 
I don’t have any need for this app and in these tough financial times I am sad to be dealing with this
Plus, the price doesn’t even match their current advertised price (not that I would have done that anyways)
author: Svetti Baulz
